notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two movable leaves of the upper cabinet are reported separately, and their brief close-and-reopen sequence at frames 448-464 is retained as two distinct episodes per leaf.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, manipulates both doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop through two open-close cycles, opens and closes a nearby top drawer, then closes the cabinet and refrigerator.
